items.summary: Site Factory disposition: preserve containment-only execution. Do not admit new site builds while delivery is saturated and launch, legal, security, measurement, and rollback evidence remains incomplete. Maintain the existing three-site scaffold pipeline as readiness-only records, with no domains, spend, deployment, analytics configuration, affiliate activation, or public launch. Strongest candidate is complicated.work because its scaffold, preview inspection, and compliance evidence are available; the single next step is to complete its existing readiness packet with dated owner, preview/build, compliance, security, measurement-boundary, rollback, and explicit-blocker evidence. After that packet is verified and capacity clears, reassess implementation admission. No new telemetry or unsupported outcome claims.
